text: In the artemisinic acid engineering project, the key rate-limiting enzyme of the yeast mevalonate pathway that was overexpressed to increase flux is ___.
explanation: HMG-CoA reductase catalyzes a key committed and rate-limiting step of the mevalonate pathway. Overexpressing it was one of the critical engineering steps, alongside introducing amorphadiene synthase and CYP71AV1, that enabled high-titer artemisinic acid production in engineered yeast.
